---

**Best move:** Kg3

**Main line:** Kg3 gxh5 Kxh3 Kf5 Kg3 Kxg5 h6 Kf4

**Motif:** quietMove

**Coaching Note:**
White's h3 pawn is undefended after g4. Instead of recapturing immediately with hxg4 (equal exchange), move your king to g3 to attack it. When White captures your h5 pawn with gxh5, you recapture with Kxh3, activating your king while eliminating two pawns. Your centralized king in the resulting endgame is stronger than a passive position. **Look for undefended pawns your opponent's pieces protect poorly—an active king attacking them is often more valuable than a passive capture.**
